main.description: Generated contract for net.openfederation.server.getPublicConfig. Includes the migration policies (accounts, pseudonyms, communities) and the PLC directory URL, for clients moving an account or community here. Also the custody policy (identity: custodyAllowed, custodyDefault, pseudonymsEnabled, deviceSigningAllowed; ADR-003), and appearance.defaultPreset: the dashboard look (pds-basic, openfederation, opennewsrooms) a person sees until they choose their own.
